table.name: attendance
table.purpose: Junction table linking members to events they attended; each row records one member's attendance at one event (likely a student organization, given events like 'Habitat for Humanity', 'Food Bank', 'Lacrosse game', and related tables budget/expense/income/major).

col_001.name: event_id
col_001.description: Reference to the event table (Airtable-style record id). Identifies which event the attendance record is for.

col_002.name: member_id
col_002.description: Reference to the member table (Airtable-style record id). Identifies which member attended the event.

table.name: budget
table.purpose: Budget line items for club/organization events: each row is a budget category (e.g. Food, Advertisement) allocated to a specific event, tracking the allocated amount, amount spent, and remaining amount, plus a status. Referenced by expense records that draw against these budget lines.

col_001.name: budget_id
col_001.description: Primary key; unique record identifier (Airtable-style 'rec...' ID) for the budget line item. Referenced by expense.col_007, linking expenses to their budget line.

col_002.name: category
col_002.description: Budget category/line item name, e.g. Food, Advertisement, Parking, Speaker Gifts, Club T-Shirts.

col_003.name: amount_spent
col_003.description: Amount already spent against this budget line (currency, likely USD). Zero for open/planning items; grows as expenses are recorded. In samples, spent + remaining equals the allocated total.

col_004.name: amount_remaining
col_004.description: Remaining balance of the budget line (currency). Equals allocated total minus spent; can be negative (min -24.25) when overspent. Sample values like 0.41/0.75 suggest cents-level tracking.

col_005.name: amount_allocated
col_005.description: Total amount allocated to the budget line (currency, whole dollars). Consistent with spent + remaining in sample rows (e.g. 67.81 + 7.19 = 75).

col_006.name: status
col_006.description: Lifecycle status of the budget line: Planning, Open, or Closed.

col_007.name: event_id
col_007.description: Foreign key to event.col_001; the event this budget line belongs to. Each event has several budget lines (many_to_one).

table.name: event
table.purpose: Events (meetings, games, guest speakers, community service, socials) of an organization, likely a student club, with date, type, location, and planning status. Referenced by attendance and budget records.

col_001.name: event_id
col_001.description: Primary key; Airtable-style record id (rec...). Referenced by attendance and budget tables.

col_002.name: event_name
col_002.description: Name/title of the event (e.g. 'Officers meeting - March', 'Habitat for Humanity').

col_003.name: event_datetime
col_003.description: Date and time the event occurs, ranging Sep 2019 to May 2020 (academic year).

col_004.name: event_type
col_004.description: Category of event: Meeting, Guest Speaker, Game, Community Service, Social, Budget, Election, etc.

col_005.name: description
col_005.description: Free-text description/notes of the event; null for about half the rows (often meetings).

col_006.name: location
col_006.description: Location of the event: campus room (MU 215), campus stadiums, or street addresses; null for some events.

col_007.name: status
col_007.description: Event status: Planning, Open, or Closed (lifecycle of the event).

table.name: expense
table.purpose: Club/organization expense ledger: each row is a single expense item (description, date, amount, approver, budget category) recorded during the fall 2019 term (Aug–Nov 2019).

col_001.name: expense_id
col_001.description: Primary key; unique record identifier (Airtable-style 'rec...' ID).

col_002.name: description
col_002.description: Free-text description of what was purchased (e.g. 'Posters', 'Pizza', 'Water, chips, cookies', 'Club shirts').

col_003.name: expense_date
col_003.description: Date the expense was incurred, ranging 2019-08-20 to 2019-11-19 (fall semester).

col_004.name: amount
col_004.description: Expense amount in dollars (min 6.00, max 295.12, mean ~65.19).

col_005.name: approved
col_005.description: Boolean flag, always 'true' when present (31/32 rows; one null). Likely an approval/reimbursed flag, but since only one value is observed its exact meaning (approved vs. paid vs. reimbursed) is uncertain.

col_006.name: member_id
col_006.description: Reference to member table (the member who incurred or submitted the expense); only 3 distinct members among the 32 expenses.

col_007.name: budget_id
col_007.description: Reference to budget table, i.e. the budget category/line the expense is charged to (e.g. Advertisement, Food, Parking).

table.name: income
table.purpose: Records of money received by a student organization (club): membership dues payments plus occasional fundraising, sponsorship, and school/Student Government appropriations, each row linked to the member who paid or secured the income. Dates fall in Sep–Oct 2019, consistent with a semester of club activity.

col_001.name: income_id
col_001.description: Primary key; opaque record identifier (Airtable-style 'rec...' ID) uniquely identifying each income entry.

col_002.name: income_date
col_002.description: Date the income was received, ranging 2019-09-01 to 2019-10-31.

col_003.name: amount
col_003.description: Amount of income in dollars. 33 of 36 rows are $50 (the standard membership dues amount); the three non-dues entries are $200, $1000, and $3000 (fundraising, sponsorship, school appropriation).

col_004.name: income_type
col_004.description: Source/category of the income: 'Dues' (33 rows), plus one each of 'Fundraising', 'Sponsorship', and 'School Appropration' (sic, likely 'School Appropriation').

col_005.name: notes
col_005.description: Optional free-text note describing the income; present only for the three non-dues entries (e.g. 'Annual funding from Student Government.', 'Secured donations to help pay for speaker gifts.', 'Ad revenue for use on flyers used to advertise upcoming events.').

col_006.name: member_id
col_006.description: Reference to member.col_001, the member associated with the income (the person who paid dues or secured the fundraising/sponsorship). Null for one row (likely the school appropriation, which has no individual member).

table.name: major
table.purpose: Lookup table of academic majors offered by a university (likely Utah State University, given the department and college names). Each row is one major, with its owning department and college. Referenced by member, presumably to record each member's major.

col_001.name: major_id
col_001.description: Primary key. Airtable-style record ID ('rec...' prefix) uniquely identifying each major; referenced by member.col_009 (a member's major).

col_002.name: major_name
col_002.description: Name of the academic major/degree program (e.g., 'History', 'Environmental Engineering'). Unique across the 113 rows.

col_003.name: department
col_003.description: Name of the academic department or school administering the major (e.g., 'History Department', 'Applied Economics Department').

col_004.name: college
col_004.description: Name of the college the major belongs to (e.g., 'College of Agriculture and Applied Sciences', 'College of Engineering').

table.name: member
table.purpose: Roster of student organization members (a club at 'lpu.edu'), one row per member, with contact info, membership status/role, t-shirt size, and academic major. Referenced by attendance, expense, and income records.

col_001.name: member_id
col_001.description: Primary key; opaque record identifier (Airtable-style 'rec...' ID) for each member. Referenced by attendance, expense, and income tables.

col_004.name: email
col_004.description: Member's email address, in the pattern firstname.lastname@lpu.edu (university email).

col_005.name: status
col_005.description: Membership status/role: 'Member' (regular active member), 'Inactive', or an officer role (President, Secretary, Treasurer).

col_006.name: t_shirt_size
col_006.description: Member's t-shirt size (Small, Medium, Large, X-Large); likely for club apparel orders.

col_007.name: phone
col_007.description: Member's phone number (US format, some with area code in parentheses, some not; 555 exchange numbers indicate synthetic/sample data).

col_008.name: zip_code
col_008.description: Member's home ZIP code (US postal code), referencing zip_code lookup table.

col_009.name: major_id
col_009.description: Reference to the member's academic major in the major lookup table; null for some members (e.g., inactive ones), so major is optional.

table.name: zip_code
table.purpose: US ZIP code reference table: one row per ZIP code with its USPS type, city, county, and state (name and abbreviation). Referenced by member (member's ZIP code).

col_001.name: zip_code
col_001.description: 5-digit US ZIP code; primary key of the table, referenced by member.col_008.

col_002.name: zip_type
col_002.description: USPS ZIP code type: Standard, PO Box, or Unique (organization-specific).

col_003.name: city
col_003.description: City (or post office / place name) associated with the ZIP code.

col_004.name: county
col_004.description: County (or county-equivalent such as borough, municipio, census area) containing the ZIP code.

col_005.name: state_name
col_005.description: Full state name (includes territories, e.g. Puerto Rico).

col_006.name: state_code
col_006.description: Two-letter USPS state/territory abbreviation matching col_005.
